sections.title: Collectibles — what to find, and how much
sections.intro: Every collectible the official descriptions count, and what the game asks you to do with it. Sweep one region at a time and check the collection menu as you go.

items.title: Collectible Cards — 3 full sets
items.counts: 3 sets · trophy: Don't Touch My Deck (Silver)
items.tip: Cards hide around Leonida. Pick the set with the fewest cards missing, hunt its cards across one region before moving on, and check the collection menu after each find. A set counts only when every card in it is found.

items.title: WAiNK It — 100 locations
items.tip: A pure exploration count. Pair it with the full-map sweep and the vehicle count: one long road trip across the state moves all three at once.

items.title: Meditation spots — every spot
items.counts: Every spot in Leonida · trophy: Positive Mental Attitude (Bronze)
items.tip: The official description gives no count, so use the in-game map markers and tick each spot off as you meditate there. Do not assume a number the description never states.

items.title: Vehicles — discover 100
items.tip: Drive or ride each one and the game logs it. Try every car, bike, boat and truck you pass rather than sticking to one favourite.

items.title: Explore all of Leonida
items.counts: The whole state · trophy: The Goodtime State (Bronze)
items.tip: Drive every road and visit every region. The in-game map shows what is still blank — sweep the far edges last, when the story has opened the whole map.

items.title: Stranger strands — 8 strands
items.tip: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more. Play each strand to its final mission; a strand left half-done stalls this trophy and the roadmap's second stage.

items.title: 100% completion
items.counts: Full completion · trophy: A Long Road (Gold)
items.tip: The game's own 100% counter: story, strangers, activities, collectibles and the rest, all finished. Treat it as the last gold before the platinum and let the checklist show what is still open.

sections.title: Activities — the counted challenges
sections.intro: The activities the game counts toward trophies. Each entry gives the target the official description states and the order that wastes the least time.

items.title: Shooting Range — 42 gold medals
items.tip: The hardest activity trophy. Work the challenge list one weapon at a time and replay any silver until it turns gold; leave the weapon you are worst with for a fresh session.

items.title: Races — win 20 different events
items.counts: 20 wins · trophy: Earn Cash, Not Kudos (Bronze)
items.tip: Twenty distinct race events, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list across Leonida and tick each event off as you win it.

items.title: Top Fun drone races — a win at every location
items.tip: Learn each course on a practice run, then race to win. The description does not list how many locations there are, so clear each one as you find it.

items.title: Stunts — 250
items.tip: Jumps, near-misses and airtime, as the game counts them. Take them as you drive through the whole playthrough, not in one grinding session — the count climbs on its own.

items.title: Challenges — 50 of any kind
items.tip: Driving, shooting, exploration and more. Pick the easy ones first; fifty is a fraction of the full list, so there is no need to chase the hard ones.

items.title: Fishing — beat Cal
items.counts: One challenge · trophy: Baited My Tackle (Bronze)
items.tip: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Learn the fishing rhythm on a quiet cast first, then take the challenge when you are landing fish cleanly.

items.title: Arcade — finish one game
items.tip: Complete one arcade game. Pick the game you are best at and play it through — a half-finished run does not count.

items.title: Bowling — a full game
items.counts: One full game · trophy: Let's Go Bowling (Bronze)
items.tip: Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley. It is also a missable moment, so play the game while you are there rather than planning to come back.

items.title: Hunting — Fair Game
items.tip: The hunt is a counted activity in its own right. Take it slowly, track the animal rather than chasing it, and finish the hunt you start.

items.title: Combat Focus — five in one use
items.tip: Combat Focus counts only the enemies taken down inside a single use, so set the attempt up first: wait until five enemies group up close together, trigger it, and chain the takedowns before it ends. One or two at a time will not count — if the group scatters, back off and try again.

items.title: Melee drive-by — Ten Pin
items.tip: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by: strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon, not a gun. Line the shot up on the approach, swing as you pass, and take a few practice runs first.

items.title: Rhino tank — Challenging Tank
items.tip: The description is a joke with a tank in it — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino without spelling out the ask. Take the first Rhino you can reach and let the trophy fire; the in-game hint is the authority here.

sections.title: Money — launder it, spend it, park it
sections.intro: The money trophies are a clean-up stage of their own: earn, clean, spend, and park the results. Keep a cash reserve — the last purchases are usually the priciest.

items.title: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills
items.tip: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists. Hand them to your contacts to clean them; small jobs add up, and the count climbs across the whole playthrough.

items.title: Spend $100,000 across all shops
items.tip: Weapons, clothes, cars — anything the shops sell. Buy what you actually use; a big purchase closes the gap at the end, so save one for last.

items.title: Buy all garage properties
items.tip: Save up and buy garages as they appear on the property market. Keep a cash reserve — the last one is usually the most expensive.

items.title: Register 10 vehicles — Scooter Bros
items.tip: Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten different vehicles — the ones you drive anyway. Use the app, not a shop counter.

items.title: Bank vaults — rob 5 and escape
items.tip: Five bank vaults robbed and escaped. Plan the getaway before the robbery, with a fast car parked close — the escape is the hard half of each one.

items.title: Armored truck — rob 1
items.counts: 1 truck · trophy: A Classic Blitz Play (Bronze)
items.tip: One armored truck, robbed clean. Watch for trucks on their routes in free roam and hit one when you have a getaway ready, not on a whim.

items.title: Marked Bills — where they come from
items.counts: Robberies and heists · trophy: Dime on the Dollar (Bronze)
items.tip: Every partner robbery and heist pays partly in Marked Bills, which are useless until laundered. Do the robberies first and the laundering follows on its own — hand the bills to your contacts in steady batches as you earn them, and the $250,000 total builds without a separate grind at the end.

items.title: Laundering route — small batches, steady total
items.counts: $250,000 in batches · trophy: Dime on the Dollar (Bronze)
items.tip: Launder in small, regular batches through your contacts rather than saving every Marked Bill for one big clean-up — the trophy counts the running total, so steady laundering keeps the money moving and the target in sight. Check the laundered total after each batch so you know how far is left.

items.title: Gang operations — Pest Control
items.counts: One per gang · trophy: Pest Control (Bronze)
items.tip: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, not several from the same crew. Find each gang's turf, hit its operation, and move on to the next gang's. The description does not name the gangs, so use the in-game map and markers.

sections.title: One-off moments — do them while you are passing
sections.intro: Eight trophies hang on single free-roam moments that do not come back as missions. The official descriptions tie each one to a moment, not a place — so take each moment when the game offers it, and do not plan to return for it later.

items.title: Partner escape — Hot Together
items.tip: An escape with a partner, in free roam. When a partner robbery turns into a getaway, stay with your partner and see it through instead of splitting up.

items.title: Showroom smash — Capital Offense
items.tip: A single showroom moment. The description ties it to one visit — smash your way out in classic style while you are passing the showroom, not after the story has moved on.

items.title: Take-off — Catch Me If You Can
items.counts: One take-off · trophy: Catch Me If You Can (Bronze)
items.tip: A take-off the description ties to a single moment. When the chance comes, take it — the moment does not wait for a better plan.

items.title: A cocktail — In The Beginning…
items.counts: One moment · trophy: In The Beginning… (Bronze)
items.tip: The description ties this trophy to a single early moment. Take it when the game offers it; an early moment is the easiest one to walk past.

items.title: A robbery streak — Retail Therapy
items.tip: Three shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing the wanted level between them. Plan a short route past three shops and keep moving — if the heat drops between robberies, the streak resets and you start over.

items.title: A second attempt — Bad Luck, I Guess
items.counts: One retry · trophy: Bad Luck, I Guess (Bronze)
items.tip: A moment that only comes around twice. If the first attempt goes wrong, the retry is the trophy — take it straight away instead of leaving it for later.

items.title: A strange event — The Truth Is Out There
items.counts: One event · trophy: The Truth Is Out There (Bronze)
items.tip: A strange event in free roam. The description names no place or time, so keep an eye out while exploring and take the event when it appears.
